name: Foam Roller Adductor Roll
steps: Lie facedown propped on your forearms with a foam roller placed lengthwise alongside your body.
Bring one bent knee out to the side and rest your inner thigh directly across the foam roller.
Use your forearms and opposite leg to glide your inner thigh slowly side to side between your knee and groin.
Continue rolling smoothly with calm breathing for the target duration, then switch legs.
tips: Brace your core lightly so your lower back does not sag toward the floor while propped on your elbows.
Pause briefly over tender spots and breathe slowly rather than rushing across tight tissue.
